# Third-party parts

Models in this folder were not designed here. Each subfolder keeps the original
`README.txt` and `LICENSE.txt` from its Thingiverse download, unmodified.

| Folder | Author | Source | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dactyl-4x6-trackball/` | bad_sky26 | https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:6556207 | CC BY-SA |
| `blank-keycap/` | CASS_Designs | https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:4694984 | CC BY |

Only the parts actually used in this build are included (the Hot-Swap case
variants, the pro micro adapter and the blank keycap). The `nonHS` variants are not used.

Derivative works of the CC BY-SA parts (for example a modified
`pro_micro_adapter`) must be published under the same license with attribution.
